t: You're at the site of St Dionis Backchurch, a parish church in the Langbourn ward of the City. It was medieval in origin, and after the Great Fire of London it was rebuilt to designs by Christopher Wren. That was part of his huge task of rebuilding fifty-two City churches, with St Paul's Cathedral as his masterpiece. The church is gone now. It was demolished in 1878. Philip Jackson, who lived from 1658 to 1724, was buried here.
